requirements: Connect First Avenue from existing Ninth terminal to the assigned Tenth junction using narrowly derived road/sidewalk/collision bounds.

Preserve all 295 existing model/scene pairs, Seventh-only address HUD, original game and private screenshots.
Resolve the separate protected core asset in the new engine before exposing the eastern block; do not omit its six Tenth planes or replace them with generic geometry.
Account explicitly for connector/context buildings between Ninth and Tenth; road access is not facade-edit authorization.
